natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing required signup fields improve time-to-value and first-week activation. This directly addresses the current funnel deterioration while avoiding the retention downside previously associated with aggressive discounting. Verify both archived records before committing, and monitor qualified activation and downstream retention rather than optimizing completion alone.
